findings.claim: enqueue() now silently clamps out-of-range priority instead of rejecting it, violating INV-2.
findings.failure_scenario: Calling enqueue(queue, 'task-1', 42) previously raised InvalidPriorityError; now it silently creates a task with priority=9, masking a caller bug (e.g. a miscomputed priority) and inserting a task at max priority when the caller may have intended the request to fail.
